themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints spiked to 37 THIS WEEK, a 1873% increase versus the 1.9-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 25.76), suggesting a sudden wave of code violations, illegal conversions, or unpermitted occupancies in Greenwich Village/SoHo that aligns with the community board's repeated budget requests for housing inspections.
evidence: 37 Building/Use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average (1873% spike, z-score 25.76)
Community board has submitted [01] housing inspection request repeatedly as unsolved priority
1377 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (1221 alterations), suggesting active construction/conversion activity
reporting_angles: What triggered the sudden spike in code violations this week? Interview DOB and landlords.
Profile residents living in potentially illegal conversions and their safety concerns; connect to community board's long-standing inspection funding gap.

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Vehicles Accumulating
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned Vehicle complaints reached 11 THIS WEEK, a 418% jump from the 2.1-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 7.0), indicating a potential environmental and safety hazard concentrated in a district already struggling with sanitation capacity.
evidence: 11 Abandoned Vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.1 weekly average (418% spike, z-score 7.0)
Community board has repeatedly requested increased sanitation trucks and equipment
Aligns with broader sanitation theme: 356 Street Condition complaints over 90 days
reporting_angles: Map the geographic concentration of abandoned vehicles this week; investigate whether NYPD towing capacity is overwhelmed.
Connect to community board's budget requests for sanitation equipment; ask if understaffing is delaying vehicle removal.

themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Enforcement Spike
themes_detail.summary: Mobile Food Vendor complaints surged to 5 LAST WEEK, a 700% increase from the 0.6-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 6.29), suggesting either a sudden influx of unlicensed vendors or intensified resident complaints in a historically gentrifying neighborhood.
evidence: 5 Mobile Food Vendor complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 6.29)
Hell Gate food feature (Kimbapalooza, 2026-03-19) suggests active street food culture in the district
Potential overlap with panhandling complaints (9 LAST WEEK, 300% spike, z-score 4.85)
reporting_angles: Are residents complaining about unlicensed vendors, or are licensed food vendors expanding in response to demand?
Investigate enforcement actions by Department of Health; connect to broader street vending policy debate in the city.

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Wave 3 Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints peaked at 45 three weeks ago, a 386% increase from the 9.2-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 6.33), though the spike has already passed; still worth investigating whether it signals underlying conditions (gang activity, reduced cleaning) in the district.
evidence: 45 Graffiti complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 9.2 weekly average (386% spike, z-score 6.33)
Community board has repeatedly requested Argus surveillance cameras and forestry services, suggesting open-space maintenance gaps
Temporal alignment with other disorder signals (panhandling, abandoned vehicles)
reporting_angles: Did the graffiti spike reflect organized tagging activity or a temporary maintenance gap? Interview Parks Dept.
Connect to community board's longstanding request for surveillance cameras as a deterrent.

themes_detail.label: Parks & Animal Nuisance Issues
themes_detail.summary: Animal in a Park complaints hit 3 THIS WEEK, a 380% increase from the 0.6-complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.91), alongside Maintenance or Facility complaints at 29 LAST WEEK (307% spike), suggesting deteriorating park conditions and wildlife problems in Greenwich Village/SoHo's public spaces.
evidence: 3 Animal in a Park complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (380% spike, z-score 4.91)
29 Maintenance or Facility complaints LAST WEEK vs. 7.1 weekly average (307% spike, z-score 4.58)
Community board has repeatedly requested park upgrades and forestry services funding
reporting_angles: What animals are residents reporting? Rats, pigeons, or wildlife? Investigate Parks Dept. response times.
Visit affected parks (Washington Square Park, Hudson River Greenway, etc.) and document maintenance gaps.
